about.title: About EarthRadar
about.intro: EarthRadar is an educational PWA in the PezzaliAPP family. It answers the question "what's happening on Earth right now?" by combining public USGS, NASA, NOAA, CelesTrak, OpenSky and Open-Meteo data.
about.sisterIntro: EarthRadar is part of the PezzaliAPP Earth & Space trilogy:
about.sources: USGS · NASA GIBS · NASA FIRMS · NASA EONET · NASA EPIC · CelesTrak · OpenSky Network · Open-Meteo · RainViewer · wheretheiss.at · OpenStreetMap

disclaimer.title: EarthRadar — Notice
disclaimer.body: Educational tool based on public USGS, NASA, NOAA, CelesTrak, OpenSky, Open-Meteo data. It does NOT replace official civil-protection, air-navigation, seismology, operational meteorology or planetary-defense systems. Satellite positions are propagated from public TLEs (typical km-level uncertainty in LEO).
disclaimer.short: Educational tool. Does not replace official operational systems.
